description: Which crosstab clause shapes over PV are accepted, with which Fields (Name, Type, Size) and cells, and with which error numbers where refused: two aggregates in TRANSFORM, a non-aggregate, no GROUP BY, no alias for the aggregate, an expression over the aggregate, two row-heading columns, two pivot expressions, ORDER BY before and after PIVOT, WHERE, HAVING, an expression row heading, an expression pivot, the pivot equal to the row heading, a crosstab as a derived table, a derived-table source, and a LEFT JOIN source? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
